title: SEKA ExAero road frameset
notes: Exact current road-model page supports 820 g RDC and 935 g standard size-54 unpainted frame claims, each ±35 g and excluding paint/metal hardware; 32 mm tire clearance; BSA 68; UDH; seven sizes with 408 mm chainstays; Gladius/ALTA cockpit options; separate MAG bottles; and manufacturer CFD/wind-tunnel claims. It is distinct from ExAero GR.
